AnimatedPoint.description:
A position that can move along curves between its keyframes.

Its JSON is an `Animated<Vec2>` plus optional spatial tangents per keyframe. With them,
the value travels the cubic Bezier through this keyframe's `out_tangent` and the next's
`in_tangent`, at the speed its timing curve sets along the arc length. Without them it
moves in a straight line.

AudioEffect.description:
A serializable single-input audio effect applied to a clip or track bus.

Sidechain ducking takes a second input, so it is authored per track through [`Ducking`].

oneOf.description: Cascaded biquad sections.

bands.description: Ordered filter sections, 1 to [`MAX_EQ_BANDS`] of them.

oneOf.description: Lookahead dynamic range compression.

attack_ms.description: Attack time in milliseconds, positive and at most [`MAX_ENVELOPE_MS`].

lookahead_ms.description: Lookahead in milliseconds, at most [`MAX_LOOKAHEAD_MS`]. Reported as graph latency.

release_ms.description: Release time in milliseconds, positive and at most [`MAX_ENVELOPE_MS`].

threshold_db.description: Level above which gain reduction begins, in decibels from [`MIN_LEVEL_DB`] to 0.

oneOf.description: Schroeder reverberation.

channels.description:
The stream's channels the clip plays, by index. One index plays that channel as a mono
source; two play a stereo pair, left then right. Absent plays every channel, folded by
speaker position. At most two distinct indices.

effects.description: Ordered single-input effects applied before the track bus, at most [`MAX_CHAIN_EFFECTS`].

fade_in.description: Fade-in duration measured from the clip's timeline start. Non-negative.

fade_out.description: Fade-out duration measured back from the clip's timeline end. Non-negative.

muted.description: Silences this clip without removing it.

preserve_pitch.description:
Keeps the clip's pitch when its speed is not 1 by time-stretching instead of resampling.
No effect at speed 1, on loops or on freezes.

stream.description:
The source's audio stream the clip plays, counted from 0 over the file's audio streams in
container order. Absent plays the stream the host picks by default.

AudioStreamShape.description: An audio stream's channel count and sample rate.

BlendSpace.description:
The color space in which blend modes are evaluated.

Compositing is always premultiplied; this chooses what the blend formulas see. Contrast
modes such as overlay and soft-light match design tools only in
[`BlendSpace::SrgbEncoded`].

oneOf.description: Linear light, where blending is physically meaningful.
sRGB-encoded values, as design tools and CSS blend.

CacheIntent.description: Whether a runtime may keep and reuse a clip's rendered picture.

oneOf.description: The runtime decides, keeping pictures whose inputs it can identify.
Keep it ahead of other pictures, and bake its range when a host bakes render caches.
Always render it live, never reading from or writing to a cache.

CaptionCue.description: Text shown over one timeline interval.

speaker.description:
Who says it, as the source names them (a WebVTT voice), at most 64 bytes. A track style
of that name applies when the cue names no style.

style.description: The name of one of the track's `styles`, applied over its style.

text.description:
The text, a string or runs; `\n` starts a line. Non-empty, at most
[`MAX_TEXT_CONTENT_BYTES`] bytes. Run times are from the cue's start and lie within it.

timeline_range.description: When the cue shows. Non-empty and not before zero.

Captions.description: What a caption track shows: its cues, in its style.

cues.description: Cues in timeline order, none overlapping; a track shows one cue at a time.

style.description: The style every cue starts from.

styles.description:
Named changes to `style` for cues that name one or whose speaker has one. At most
[`MAX_CAPTION_STYLES`], names 1 to 64 bytes.

Clip.description: A reference to a source over independent timeline and source ranges.

audio.description: Presentation controls applied to this clip's audio.

blend_mode.description: Artistic operation used when this clip is composited over earlier layers.

cache.description:
Whether a runtime may keep and reuse the clip's rendered picture. Never changes what
renders.

composition.description:
The composition graph that builds the clip's picture from its source, with the clip's
time mapping onto it. Without one the clip shows its source as is. Visual clips only.

masks.description:
Shapes that limit where the clip is visible, applied in order after its composition and
before its transform. At most [`crate::MAX_CLIP_MASKS`]; visual clips only.

matte.description: Another visual clip whose picture sets where this clip is visible.

source_range.description: Interval read from the source timeline.

time_map.description: How timeline time maps onto the source range.

timeline_range.description: Destination interval on the project timeline.

ClipBlendMode.description:
Blend mode, from W3C Compositing and Blending Level 1 (CSS `mix-blend-mode`) with the
specification's formulas, plus `plus-lighter` from Level 2.

oneOf.description: Preserve source color and apply source-over coverage.
Multiply source and backdrop components.
Inverse-multiply source and backdrop components.
Multiply dark backdrop regions and screen light regions.
The darker of source and backdrop, per channel.
The lighter of source and backdrop, per channel.
Brighten the backdrop to reflect the source.
Darken the backdrop to reflect the source.
Multiply or screen, depending on the source.
Darken or lighten, depending on the source: a diffused hard light.
The absolute difference of source and backdrop.
Like difference, with lower contrast.
The source's hue with the backdrop's saturation and luminosity.
The source's saturation with the backdrop's hue and luminosity.
The source's hue and saturation with the backdrop's luminosity.
The source's luminosity with the backdrop's hue and saturation.

Source and backdrop added, premultiplied color and alpha each clamped to 1 (Add or Linear
Dodge in design tools). It replaces source-over rather than blending inside it.

ClipComposition.description:
A clip's use of a [`Composition`], and how its time maps onto it.

Composition time is `offset + (t - clip start) * scale` for timeline time `t`, rounded
down to a tick. Moving a clip keeps its offset so the animation moves with it; trimming
its start by `d` adds `d * scale` to the offset so the rest stays in place. A negative
offset holds settings at their first keyframe and media nodes at their first frame.

offset.description: Composition time at the clip's start.

ClipEffect.description:
One versioned effect invocation: a composition's effect or transition node, or a timeline
transition.

params.description:
Named parameter values, constant or keyframed. Omitted entries use definition defaults.

Keyframe times are composition times in a composition node and timeline times in a
timeline transition. A parameter's keyframes share one value type, and `enum` and `bool`
keyframes only hold. Interpolated overshoot is clamped to the parameter's range; an
authored value outside it is an error.

resources.description: Named external resources matched against the effect definition.

version.description: Exact effect definition version required by the project.

ClipTransition.description: A two-input transition over the overlap of two visual clips.

easing.description:
Timing curve applied to the transition's linear progress. The eased progress is clamped
to `0..=1`.

effect.description: Versioned transition shader and named parameter values.

from_clip.description: Clip sampled as transition progress zero.

timeline_range.description: Half-open timeline interval over which both clips must be active.

to_clip.description: Clip sampled as transition progress one.

ColorMatrix.description: Coefficients used to decode source components.

oneOf.description: SD BT.601 YUV coefficients.
HD BT.709 YUV coefficients.
BT.2020 non-constant-luminance YUV coefficients.
Source components are already RGB.

dynamic_range.description: SDR or HDR; HDR exactly when `transfer` is PQ or HLG ([`Self::is_consistent`]).

matrix.description: YUV-to-RGB coefficient family, or RGB for already converted sources.

ColorPipeline.description:
How sources' colors come into the working space.

The working space is display-referred linear light with BT.709 primaries, `1.0` being SDR
white (100 nits); every export is SDR BT.709. SDR sources decode through the sRGB EOTF and
wide-gamut ones are converted to BT.709. An HDR (PQ or HLG) source is either refused or
linearized, converted to BT.709, and tone-mapped from [`Self::hdr_peak_nits`] to SDR white
by the ITU-R BT.2390 EETF on each pixel's largest component, preserving hue.

hdr_peak_nits.description:
The luminance, in nits, HDR sources are taken to peak at: PQ above it is clipped, HLG is
displayed at it, and the tone map brings it to SDR white. Within [`HDR_PEAK_NITS_RANGE`].

ColorPrimaries.description: RGB primary chromaticities a source or export declares.

oneOf.description: SD video primaries.
HD video and sRGB primaries.
Wide-gamut BT.2020 primaries, normally indicating HDR input.
Studio/video range.
Full component range.

Composition.description: An acyclic graph of image operations with one selected output.

controls.description: The node settings a group node may set, by name.

inputs.description:

nodes.description: The graph's nodes. Order has no meaning; a node may name a later node as its input.

output.description:
The node whose image is the composition's picture. A composition without one saves but
cannot be rendered.

CompositionControl.description:
A node setting a composition exposes to group nodes: an effect or transition parameter of
one of its nodes.

name.description: The name a group node sets it by; unique in the composition.

bypass.description:
Whether the node passes its [`NodeOp::bypass_input`] through unchanged. A node without
inputs cannot be bypassed.

op.description: What the node does, with its inputs and settings.

offset.description: How far into the pattern the stroke starts.

pattern.description:
Alternating dash and gap lengths, as fractions of the shorter side: one to
[`MAX_DASH_ENTRIES`] non-negative entries, not all zero. An odd count repeats once more to
pair up.

oneOf.description: CSS flexbox.
CSS grid.

Ducking.description: Sidechain ducking authored on the track that is attenuated.

oneOf.description: Progress advances at a constant rate.

gain_db.description:

q.description: Resonance, within [`EQ_Q_RANGE`]. Larger values produce narrower bands.

EqBandKind.description: The filter shape of one equalizer band.

oneOf.description: Bell-shaped parametric band.

Second-order high-pass.

oneOf.description: Amplitude moves linearly. Two linear fades over one overlap dip by 6 dB.

Generator.description:
The picture of a generated source.

A generated picture has the canvas's size and aspect. Positions are normalized, `(0, 0)`

picture is the same at any render resolution. A fill never changes over time; text
changes only through its style's animators; shapes and layouts may change.

Shapes drawn from an ordered content tree, as an After Effects or Lottie shape layer draws
them. Every value in the tree may be keyframed in picture time.

items.description: The content tree, front first. See [`ShapeItem`].

drawn with the host's registered fonts.

style.description:
How it looks and where it lies. The font size is at most
[`MAX_TEXT_GENERATOR_FONT_SIZE`].

text.description:
The text, a string or runs; `\n` starts a line. Non-empty, at most
[`MAX_TEXT_CONTENT_BYTES`] bytes. Run times are picture time.

oneOf.description:
Boxes laid out by CSS flexbox around their text and shapes, with the engine's fonts. Any
value in the tree may be keyframed in picture time. See [`LayoutNode`].

root.description: The root box: the whole picture.

offset.description: Position along the gradient, in `0..=1`, not before the previous stop.

GridAutoFlow.description: How a grid places items that have no placement of their own.

oneOf.description: Filling each row, adding rows.

Insets.description: A length on each side of a box: one length for every side, the CSS shorthand of one to four lengths ("8px 16px": top first, clockwise), or the sides object, missing sides 0.

Interpolation from one keyframe to the next.

Values interpolate numerically: a rotation from 0 to 720 degrees turns twice. A host that
wants the shortest path normalizes its keyframe values.

Move to the next value at a constant rate.
Move to the next value along a CSS `cubic-bezier()` timing curve.

LayoutBorder.description: A border inside the border box, as wide on every side.

paint.description: What covers the border. Positions are normalized to the border box.

LayoutInset.description:
Where an absolute box lies in its parent's padding box. A missing side is auto; with
neither `left` nor `right`, the box keeps its flow position on that axis.

bottom.description: Distance from the parent's bottom padding edge.

left.description: Distance from the parent's left padding edge.

right.description: Distance from the parent's right padding edge.

top.description: Distance from the parent's top padding edge.

LayoutLength.description: A length: a number is a fraction of the layout picture's shorter side, "<n>px" pixels of the project canvas, "<n>%" a percent of the parent's content box along the field's axis.

LayoutNode.description:
One box of a layout tree.

A box lays its children out by flexbox (the default) or grid. It is a container with
children, a leaf with text or shape content, and empty otherwise (a spacer or decoration).
Each box draws background, then border, then content. Boxes draw in document order;
reversed directions and grid placement move them but do not change paint order.

align_content.description:
Where lines of a wrapping flex container, or a grid's rows, lie across the container.
Default `stretch`.

align_items.description: Where children lie across the main axis, or in their grid areas' rows. Default `stretch`.

align_self.description:
Where the box lies across its flex container's main axis, or in its grid area's row.
`None` follows the parent's `align_items`.

background.description:
What covers the border box, rounded by `border_radius`. Positions are normalized to the
border box.

border.description: A border inside the border box.

border_radius.description:
The corner radius of the border box. At least 0; default 0. Capped at half the box's
shorter side.

children.description: Boxes laid out in this one, in document (and paint) order. Not with `text` or `shape`.

column_gap.description: Space between columns, in place of `gap`. At least 0.

display.description:
How the box lays its children out. Default `flex`. Like every container field, not on a
box with text or shape content.

fill.description: What paints the text's glyphs, as a text style's `fill`. Inherited; the root's is white.

flex_basis.description: The main size before growing and shrinking. `None` is auto.

flex_direction.description: The main axis of a flex container's children. Default `row`.

flex_grow.description:
How much of a flex container's free space the box takes. At least 0; default 0. Like
every flex item field, not in a grid.

flex_shrink.description:
How much the box gives up when a flex container's space runs short. At least 0; default
1.

flex_wrap.description: Whether a flex container's children wrap onto more lines. Default `nowrap`.

font_family.description:
The family the box's text draws in, as a text style's `font_family`. Inherited; the
root's is the host's first font.

font_size.description:
Font size: positive, at most [`MAX_LAYOUT_FONT_SIZE`] of the picture's shorter side.
Inherited; the root's is 0.05.

font_weight.description:
The weight in `[1, 1000]` used to match the family's faces, as a text style's
`font_weight`. Not animated. Inherited; the root's is 400.

gap.description: Space between children, on both axes. At least 0; default 0.

grid_auto_columns.description: The size of a grid's implicit columns. Default `auto`.

grid_auto_flow.description: How a grid places items without a placement. Default `row`.

grid_auto_rows.description: The size of a grid's implicit rows. Default `auto`.

grid_column.description:
The box's columns in its grid, as CSS writes them (`2`, `"1 / 3"`, `"span 2"`). Default
`auto`.

grid_row.description: The box's rows in its grid. Default `auto`.

grid_template_columns.description:
A grid's explicit columns, as CSS writes them (`"1fr 2fr"`,
`"repeat(3, minmax(100px, 1fr))"`). Default none.

grid_template_rows.description: A grid's explicit rows. Default none.

inset.description: Where an `absolute` box lies in its parent's padding box.

justify_content.description: Where children lie along the main (for a grid, inline) axis. Default `start`.

justify_items.description: Where a grid's children lie in their grid areas' columns. Default `stretch`.

justify_self.description:
Where the box lies in its grid area's column. `None` follows the parent's
`justify_items`. Like every grid item field, not in a flex container.

letter_spacing.description:
Space after each character, as a fraction of the font size, in `[-0.5, 1]`, as a text
style's `letter_spacing`. Not animated. Inherited; the root's is 0.

line_height.description:
Baseline-to-baseline distance in font sizes, in `[0.5, 3]`, as a text style's
`line_height`. Inherited; the root's is 1.2.

margin.description: Space outside the border, written as `padding` is. Sides may be negative; no `auto`.

min_width.description: Smallest width. `None` is auto, the CSS automatic minimum size.

opacity.description: Opacity of the box and everything in it as one group, in `0..=1`. Applied after layout.

overflow.description: Whether content past the padding box is drawn. Default `visible`.

padding.description:
Space inside the border: a length, the CSS shorthand (`"8px 16px"`), or the sides object.
Sides at least 0; default 0.

position.description: Whether the box is in its parent's flow. Default `relative`.

rotation_degrees.description:
Clockwise rotation of the box and everything in it about its border-box centre, in
degrees, after layout.

row_gap.description:
Space between rows (or lines of a wrapping row flex container), in place of `gap`. At
least 0.

scale.description: Per-axis scale of the box and everything in it about its border-box centre, after layout.

shadows.description:
Shadows of the glyphs and strokes, as a text style's `shadows`. Inherited as a whole list
(as CSS `text-shadow`); the root has none.

shape.description:
Shapes drawn on a picture the size of the box's content box. Not with `children` or
`text`.

strokes.description:
Bands around the glyphs, as a text style's `strokes`. Inherited as a whole list; the root
has none.

text.description:
The box's text, wrapped at its content width in the inherited style; `\n` starts a line.
At most [`MAX_TEXT_CONTENT_BYTES`] bytes per value; may be empty. Keyframes all `hold`.
Not with `children` or `shape`.

text_align.description: How lines align within the content width. Inherited; the root's is `start`.

text_animators.description:
Per-character motion of the box's own text, Range selectors only (layout text has no
runs). At most [`crate::MAX_TEXT_ANIMATORS`], keyed in picture time. Not inherited; never
changes layout.

translate.description:
Offset of the box and everything in it after layout: the object, or one or two lengths as
CSS `translate` writes them.

width.description: Border-box width. `None` is auto. Like every item field, not on the root.

LayoutOffset.description: An offset, x right and y down: one or two lengths as CSS translate writes them (y 0 when missing), or {x, y}.

LayoutShape.description:
A box's shapes, drawn as a shapes generator draws its items on a picture the size of the
box's content box. A shape box has no size of its own.

LayoutSize.description: A length that may not be a percent: a number is a fraction of the layout picture's shorter side, "<n>px" pixels of the project canvas.

Limiter.description: Final peak limiter placed at the end of the master bus.

release_ms.description: Release time in milliseconds, positive and at most [`MAX_ENVELOPE_MS`].

threshold.description: Linear ceiling, positive and at most [`MAX_GAIN`]. One is full scale.

oneOf.description: Flat at the end point.
A half circle past the end point.
A half square past the end point.

LineJoin.description: How stroke segments meet at a vertex.

oneOf.description: Extended edges meeting at a point, up to the miter limit.
A circular arc.
A straight cut across the corner.

LinearPrimaries.description: Named RGB primaries linear-light media may be in, each with its own white point.

oneOf.description: ITU-R BT.709 and sRGB, D65 white.
ITU-R BT.2020, D65 white.
DCI-P3 primaries with a D65 white, as Display P3.
ACES AP0 (SMPTE ST 2065-1), the ACES white.
ACES AP1 (ACEScg), the ACES white.

LoopMode.description: How each pass of a [`TimeMap::Loop`] follows the one before.

oneOf.description:
Every pass plays forward from the start. Sound fades out and in over
[`LOOP_FADE_SECONDS`] at each wrap so the jump does not click.
Passes alternate forward and backward.

MaskMode.description:
How a mask combines with the coverage of the masks before it.

Coverage starts empty when the first mask adds and full otherwise, so a clip whose only
mask subtracts is visible outside the shape.

oneOf.description: Union: `c + m - c * m`.
Difference: `c * (1 - m)`.
Intersection: `c * m`.

effects.description:
Ordered single-input effects applied to the summed track buses, at most
[`MAX_CHAIN_EFFECTS`].

gain.description: Animated linear master amplitude constrained to `0..=MAX_GAIN`.

limiter.description:
Final peak limiter. Omitted means [`Limiter::default`]; an explicit `null` leaves the mix
unlimited.

Matte.description:
Another visual clip whose picture sets where this clip is visible.

The matte clip is drawn, with its own transform and effects, only into the matte and is
never composited itself. Where it is not active, coverage is zero.

mode.description: What of that picture is the coverage.

source.description: The clip whose picture is the matte.

MatteMode.description: Which property of the matte clip's picture is coverage.

oneOf.description: Its alpha.
One minus its alpha.
Its luminance over black: BT.709 weights on linear light, times alpha.
One minus that luminance.

MediaFingerprint.description:
Evidence of a source's media, each part recorded only when known.

A matching content hash proves the same bytes; without one, the other parts can only show
a difference. `modified_ms` narrows a search and never decides identity.

color.description: The color the decoded pictures carry.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

duration_ticks.description:
Where the media ends on its own timeline, in ticks: first presentation plus length (a
stream starting at 1.4 s and lasting 2 s ends at 3.4 s). Non-negative.

modified_ms.description: The file's modification time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

MediaKind.description: The payload domain of a source.

oneOf.description: A video stream, potentially with an audio stream.
An audio stream.
A still visual image.
A picture the engine draws from the source's [`Generator`]; the host supplies nothing.

A composition of the project, drawn with the source time as its own time. The host
supplies only the media its nodes read.

composition.description: The composition a [`MediaKind::Composition`] source shows; present exactly for that kind.

fingerprint.description:
What the host found at the locator when the project recorded it, so another host can tell
whether media it finds is the same. Generated sources have none.

generator.description: What a [`MediaKind::Generated`] source draws; present exactly for that kind.

has_audio.description:
Whether the media has an audio stream. This is a fact of the file, recorded the same by
every host whether or not it can decode the stream; a host that cannot plays the source
silent.

[`MediaKind::Audio`] always does. A [`MediaKind::Video`] source must declare it for its
clips on a visual track to contribute to the mix.

locator.description:
Opaque URI or host locator; the engine does not open it. Required except for
[`MediaKind::Generated`] and [`MediaKind::Composition`] sources.

provider.description:
The extension provider and settings that supply this source's media when the host's own
decoders do not read it.

MediaTime.description: A signed position or duration in timeline ticks (120 000 per second), at most the largest integer a JavaScript number holds exactly either way.

blend_mode.description: How the layer blends with the layers under it.

MissingFrames.description: How an image sequence shows a frame missing from its numbering.

oneOf.description: A sequence with a missing frame is refused.
The frame before it is shown.
Nothing is shown: a transparent frame.

NodeId.description: A stable identifier of a node within one composition graph. It has no `/`, which joins the IDs of the group and media nodes a step was drawn through.

NodeOp.description:
The operation of a [`CompositionNode`].

Animated settings are keyed in composition time (see [`ClipComposition`]).

oneOf.description:
The picture of the clip showing the composition: its source at the time-mapped source
time, or what its generated source draws.

Another visual source, read at `start` plus the composition time. Adds no sound to the
mix.

source_id.description: The source; a video, image, or generated source.

start.description: Source time shown at composition time zero. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: A picture the engine draws.
A registered effect: its input plus any named images it samples.

effect.description: The versioned effect and its parameters.

input.description: The image the effect processes; a bypassed node passes it through.

inputs.description:
The images the effect samples besides its input, by the names its definition declares
(`sample_<name>` in its shader); at most [`MAX_EFFECT_INPUTS`]. An undeclared name, or a
declared one left out, fails the frames that draw the node.

oneOf.description: A registered two-input transition at an explicit progress.

effect.description: The versioned transition and its parameters.

oneOf.description: The input placed on the canvas by a transform and opacity.

transform.description: Position, anchor, scale, rotation, and opacity.

oneOf.description: Ordered layers composited over transparency.
The input kept where a second image says.

matte.description: The image whose alpha or luminance is coverage.

mode.description: Which property of the matte image is coverage.

oneOf.description: The input kept inside shapes.

masks.description:
The shapes, combined in order; at most [`crate::MAX_CLIP_MASKS`]. Geometry is in the
input image's normalized space.

oneOf.description:
Another composition drawn in this one's time as a group: its output, with group inputs
fed from `inputs` and controls set from `controls`.

controls.description:
Values for its controls, by name; unset controls keep the composition's own value. Keyed
in composition time.

inputs.description: The image for each of its inputs, in its port order.

oneOf.description: In a composition used as a group, the image the group node gives its input `index`.

index.description: The input, in the composition's port order.

Overflow.description: Whether content past a box's padding box is drawn.

oneOf.description: Drawn.
Clipped to the padding box.

Paint.description:
A color or gradient.

Gradients interpolate premultiplied stops in linear light, so a gradient between two colors
passes through their physical mix and a stop fading to transparent does not darken its
neighbour. A bare color is read as a solid paint; paints are written back tagged.

oneOf.description: One color.
Colors along the line from `start` to `end`, constant across it.

spread.description: What lies beyond the first and last offsets.

oneOf.description: Colors along the radius of a circle.

radius.description:
The distance of offset 1 from the centre, as a fraction of the picture's shorter side.
Positive.

spread.description: What lies beyond the first and last offsets.

oneOf.description: Colors around a point: offsets 0 to 1 are one clockwise turn.

angle_degrees.description: Where offset 0 lies, in degrees clockwise from straight up.

center.description: The point the gradient turns around.

subpaths.description:
The subpaths, at most [`MAX_PATH_SUBPATHS`], with at most [`MAX_PATH_VERTICES`] vertices
in total.

PathVertex.description:
A path vertex and its tangents. The segment from `a` to `b` is the cubic Bezier through
`a.point`, `a.point + a.out_tangent`, `b.point + b.in_tangent` and `b.point`; zero tangents
make it straight.

in_tangent.description: The control point of the segment ending here, relative to `point`.

out_tangent.description: The control point of the segment starting here, relative to `point`.

in_tangent.description: The curve's second control point from the previous keyframe, relative to this value.

interpolation.description:
Interpolation from this keyframe to its successor: how fast the value travels along the
way.

out_tangent.description: The curve's first control point toward the next keyframe, relative to this value.

time.description: Timestamp of this value, as a [`Keyframe`]'s.

PolystarKind.description: What kind of figure a polystar is.

oneOf.description: Points joined by inner corners.
Points joined by straight sides.

Position.description: Whether a box is in its parent's flow.

oneOf.description: In the flow.
Out of the flow, placed by `inset`.

ProjectSettings.description: Output-wide settings independent of a renderer or encoder.

background.description:
Opaque color under every layer, in preview and export alike, so empty canvas is never
left to a host or encoder.

blend_space.description: The space in which clips' blend modes are evaluated, in preview and export alike.

color.description: How sources' colors come into the working space.

height.description:
Canvas height in output pixels, at most [`MAX_CANVAS_DIMENSION`]. The canvas area is at
most [`MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS`].

width.description: Canvas width in output pixels, at most [`MAX_CANVAS_DIMENSION`].

ProviderSource.description:
A source whose media an extension provider supplies instead of the host's video and image
decoders.

A host picks the provider by probing the bytes at import, never by file name, and records
it here so every host opens the source the same way. The engine does not read it.

oneOf.description: A static SVG document, rasterized at its shown size. The source's kind is `image`.

A GIF, animated WebP, or APNG: one cycle of frames, each with its own duration.
Repetition is the clip's. The source's kind is `video`.

A Lottie animation (JSON file or dotLottie package), evaluated at its own frames. The
source's kind is `video`.

animation.description:
The dotLottie animation shown, by ID. Absent means the package's first; always absent
for a Lottie JSON file.

oneOf.description: Still images played in order at a fixed rate. The source's kind is `video`.

frame_rate.description: The rate the frames play at.

frames.description:
Each frame's locator, in play order. `null` marks a missing number, allowed only when
`missing` says how to show it.

missing.description: How a missing frame is shown.

primaries.description:
The primaries of OpenEXR frames' linear RGB, overriding the first frame's
chromaticities. Only for OpenEXR frames.

start_number.description: The number of the first frame, as its file was numbered.

oneOf.description:
A still OpenEXR image: linear-light RGB(A), read at half precision. The source's kind is
`image`.

primaries.description:
The primaries of its linear RGB, overriding the file's chromaticities (BT.709 when the
file has none, as OpenEXR defines).

RangeShape.description: How selection rises and falls across a Range selector's range.

oneOf.description: Fully selected inside the range, partly at fractional ends.
Rising from the start to the end.
Falling from the start to the end.
Rising to the middle, falling after it.
A half circle over the range.
The triangle eased by smoothstep.

RangeUnits.description: What a Range selector's start, end and offset count in.

oneOf.description: Percents of the units.
Unit indices.

Rgb.description: An opaque color as a color picker shows it: straight, sRGB-encoded components in `0..=1`.

Rgba.description:
A straight (not premultiplied), sRGB-encoded color with alpha, each component in `0..=1`.

Read from the object or CSS hex (`"#rgb"`, `"#rgba"`, `"#rrggbb"`, `"#rrggbbaa"`, any
case). Always written back as the object, since components need not be multiples of 1/255.

RunState.description: Which runs a Timing selector selects.

oneOf.description: Runs whose time has not started.
Runs whose time holds the current time.
Runs whose time has ended.

ShapeGeometry.description: A geometry alone, as a mask's outline is.

oneOf.description: A rectangle, optionally with rounded corners.

corner_radius.description:
Corner radius, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative; capped at half the
rectangle.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description:
Full width and height before rotation: x a fraction of the picture's width, y of its
height. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: An ellipse.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description:
Full width and height before rotation: x a fraction of the picture's width, y of its
height. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: A regular polygon or star.

inner_radius.description: A star's distance of its inner corners from the centre. Non-negative.

inner_roundness.description: How round a star's inner corners are, in `0..=1`.

outer_radius.description: Distance of the points from the centre, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative.

outer_roundness.description: How round the outer corners are, in `0..=1`: 0 sharp, 1 a smooth curve through them.

points.description:
Number of points (polygon corners or star tips), from [`MIN_POLYSTAR_POINTS`] to
[`MAX_POLYSTAR_POINTS`]. A fraction is dropped when drawn, as Lottie does, so an animated
count changes one whole point at a time.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

oneOf.description: A Bezier path.

ShapeItem.description:
One entry of a shapes generator's content tree.

A group is read front to back. Geometry accumulates in its group; a fill or stroke paints
the geometry listed before it in the same group (nested groups included), and a trim cuts
and replaces that geometry. Earlier paints draw on top of later ones, as in After Effects
and Lottie.

oneOf.description:
Items drawn together through one transform and opacity. Their geometry also counts as the
enclosing group's for paints and trims after the group.

transform.description: Where the group lies, and how opaque it is.

oneOf.description: A rectangle, optionally with rounded corners.

corner_radius.description:
Corner radius, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative; capped at half the
rectangle.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description:
Full width and height before rotation: x a fraction of the picture's width, y of its
height. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: An ellipse.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

size.description:
Full width and height before rotation: x a fraction of the picture's width, y of its
height. Non-negative.

oneOf.description: A regular polygon or star.

inner_radius.description: A star's distance of its inner corners from the centre. Non-negative.

inner_roundness.description: How round a star's inner corners are, in `0..=1`.

outer_radius.description: Distance of the points from the centre, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative.

outer_roundness.description: How round the outer corners are, in `0..=1`: 0 sharp, 1 a smooth curve through them.

points.description:
Number of points (polygon corners or star tips), from [`MIN_POLYSTAR_POINTS`] to
[`MAX_POLYSTAR_POINTS`]. A fraction is dropped when drawn, as Lottie does, so an animated
count changes one whole point at a time.

rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation about the centre, in degrees.

oneOf.description: A Bezier path.

Paints the inside of the geometry listed before it in its group, as one compound path
under `rule`. Open paths are closed for it.

rule.description: Which regions of the compound path are inside.

oneOf.description: Strokes the geometry listed before it in its group.

dash.description: Dashes, or a solid stroke when absent.

miter_limit.description:
Longest a miter join reaches, as a multiple of half the width, before it is beveled. At
least 1.

width.description: Full width, as a fraction of the shorter side. Non-negative; zero draws nothing.

oneOf.description: Keeps part of the geometry listed before it in its group, by length.

end.description: Where it ends, in `0..=1`. Nothing is kept unless it is after `start`.

mode.description: Whether the span is of all the geometry together or of each part.

offset.description: Turns the span is shifted by; it wraps around a closed path.

start.description: Where the kept span starts, as a fraction of the length, in `0..=1`.

ShapeMask.description:
A shape that limits where a clip is visible.

Geometry is in the clip's source space before its transform, so the mask moves with the
clip: `(0, 0)` is the source's top-left, `(1, 1)` its bottom-right. Distances (`feather`,
`corner_radius`, polystar radii) are fractions of that space's shorter side.

feather.description:
Edge softness, non-negative; zero is the outline's antialiased edge. Coverage is blurred
by a Gaussian with standard deviation `0.3125 * feather`, a 10-90% ramp of `0.8 * feather`.

fill_rule.description: Which regions of the outline are inside it.

invert.description: Whether the mask keeps the outside of the shape instead of its inside.

mode.description: How this mask combines with the ones before it.

shape.description: The shape's outline, as a shapes generator's geometry.

ShapeTransform.description:
A group's placement. In pixel space: translate by `position`, rotate, scale, then
translate by minus `anchor`, so `anchor` lands on `position`. The default is identity.

anchor.description: The point of the items that is placed at `position`.

opacity.description:
Opacity of the group as a whole, in `0..=1`; overlapping items are composited first and
faded together.

scale.description: Per-axis scale; 1 leaves the items unscaled. Stroke widths scale with it.

Spread.description: What a linear or radial gradient shows outside its first and last stops.

oneOf.description: The end colors continue.
The gradient starts again.
The gradient runs back and forth.

StreamTopology.description: The streams a media file carries.

audio.description: The primary audio stream, if there is one.

video.description: The primary video stream, if there is one.

Subpath.description: A run of vertices joined by cubic Bezier segments.

closed.description: Whether a segment joins the last vertex back to the first.

TextAlign.description: How lines of text align within it.

oneOf.description: Left.
Centred.
Right.

TextAnimator.description: One animator: what it selects, and what it does to what it selects.

properties.description: Applied to each character in proportion to its selection.

selector.description: Gives each character its selection, in `[0, 1]`.

TextAnimatorProperties.description:
What an animator does to each character, in proportion to its selection. A property left
out does nothing.

fill.description: The fill color a fully selected character takes; a gradient fill is mixed toward it.

offset.description: Moves the character, in font sizes, +y down.

opacity.description: The opacity a fully selected character takes, in `[0, 1]`.

rotation_degrees.description: Turns the character about its centre, clockwise degrees.

scale.description: Scales the character about its centre; 1 is none. Each axis in `[0, 10]`.

stroke.description: The color every stroke of a fully selected character takes.

tracking.description:
Space added after the character, in font sizes, in `[-0.5, 1]`, as letter spacing adds
it. Lines are not re-broken.

TextBackground.description: A box behind each line of text.

padding.description: Space between the text and the box edge, as a fraction of the font size, in `[0, 2]`.

anyOf.description: Runs in order; their texts joined are the text.

TextContent.description:
A text: one string, or runs whose texts joined are the text.

Written as `"Hello"` or `[{ "text": "Hel" }, { "text": "lo", "class": ["key"] }]`.

TextRun.description: A piece of a text that animators' Class and Timing selectors can pick.

class.description:
Names Class selectors match, each 1 to 64 bytes of `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-`; at
most [`MAX_RUN_CLASSES`].

text.description:
Non-empty; `\n` starts a line. A grapheme cluster spanning two runs belongs to the run
holding its first byte.

time.description:
When the run is said, from the holder's start (a caption cue's start, or a text
generator's picture time zero).

oneOf.description: A range over the text's units, shaped at its ends, like After Effects' range selector.

based_on.description: What the range counts: characters (the default), non-space characters, words, or lines.

end.description: Where it ends, in the same range. Default 100.

offset.description: Added to start and end, in the same range. Default 0.

shape.description: How selection rises and falls across the range.

start.description:
Where the range starts: `[-100, 200]` percent, or `[-N, 2N]` units for `N` of
[`MAX_RANGE_INDEX`]. Default 0.

units.description: Whether start, end and offset are percents of the units (the default) or unit indices.

oneOf.description: Characters of timed runs, by the run's time against the current time.

ramp.description: How long the state takes to fade in and out; zero switches.

state.description: Which runs it selects: those not yet said, being said, or said.

sweep.description:
Splits each run's span over its characters in order, sweeping the run character by
character.

oneOf.description: Characters of runs that carry a class.

TextShadow.description: A shadow of a text's glyphs and strokes, behind them.

blur.description:
Blur radius in font sizes, as CSS `text-shadow` takes it (the Gaussian's standard
deviation is half of it). In `[0, 1]` ([`MAX_TEXT_SHADOW_BLUR`]).

offset.description:
Offset in font sizes, +x right, +y down; each component in `[-1, 1]`
([`MAX_TEXT_SHADOW_OFFSET`]).

TextStroke.description: A band around the glyphs and the strokes listed before it, drawn behind them.

width.description:
Band width as a fraction of the font size, positive; a text's strokes sum to at most
[`MAX_TEXT_STROKE_EXTENT`].

TextStyle.description:
How text looks and where it lies, for caption cues or a text [`crate::Generator`].

The font size is a fraction of the canvas's shorter side, the wrapping width a fraction
of the canvas width, and strokes, shadows and padding fractions of the font size. The
engine draws with its host's registered fonts, `font_family` first, then the rest in
fallback order.

Painting is bottom to top as in CSS: background boxes, shadows (last listed lowest),
strokes (outermost lowest), fill, then color glyphs.

align.description: How lines align within the text.

anchor.description:
The point of the text, background included, placed at `position`; `(0.5, 1)` is its
bottom centre.

animators.description:
Per-character motion and color, applied in order, at most [`crate::MAX_TEXT_ANIMATORS`].
Keyframes are in the holder's time (since a caption cue's start, or a text generator's
picture time). They never change line layout.

fill.description:
What paints the glyphs; a color reads as a solid paint. Gradient positions are in the
text's layout box, `(0, 0)` top-left to `(1, 1)` bottom-right, and a radial radius is a
fraction of the box's shorter side. Default solid white.

font_family.description:
The family, as the font's name table gives it (typographic family, else family), matched
ASCII case-insensitively. Missing glyphs and unknown families fall back to the other fonts
in order; `None` uses the fallback order alone. Non-empty, at most
[`MAX_FONT_FAMILY_BYTES`] bytes.

font_size.description:
Font size as a fraction of the canvas's shorter side: positive, at most
[`crate::MAX_CAPTION_FONT_SIZE`] on a caption track and [`MAX_TEXT_GENERATOR_FONT_SIZE`]
in a text generator.

font_weight.description:
The weight in `[1, 1000]` used to match a family's faces, as CSS Fonts 4 matches
`font-weight`. Variable faces draw at it, clamped to their `wght` axis; no face is
synthetically emboldened.

letter_spacing.description:
Space after each character, as a fraction of the font size, in `[-0.5, 1]`, added as CSS
`letter-spacing` does: none after a line's last character or within cursive scripts such
as Arabic. A non-zero value turns optional ligatures off.

line_height.description:
Baseline-to-baseline distance in font sizes, in `[0.5, 3]`. Each line's em box (0.8 font
sizes above the baseline, 0.2 below) is centred in a taller line.

max_width.description: Width text wraps at, as a fraction of the canvas width, in `(0, 1]`.

position.description: Where on the canvas the text's anchor lies, `(0, 0)` top-left to `(1, 1)` bottom-right.

shadows.description:
Shadows of the glyphs and strokes, the first on top, as CSS `text-shadow` lists them. At
most [`MAX_TEXT_SHADOWS`].

strokes.description:
Bands around the glyphs, innermost first, each outside the one before. At most
[`MAX_TEXT_STROKES`], widths summing to at most [`MAX_TEXT_STROKE_EXTENT`].

TextStylePatch.description:
Changes to a [`TextStyle`]. Each field set replaces the base's whole value (lists are not
merged); a field left out keeps the base's.

background.description: The box behind each line; `null` removes the base's.

font_family.description: The family; `null` draws from the fallback order alone.

TextUnit.description: The units a Range selector counts.

oneOf.description: Grapheme clusters, spaces included.
Grapheme clusters that are not white space.
UAX #29 words that hold a letter or digit; a CJK ideograph is a word.
Laid-out lines.

TimeMap.description:
How a clip plays its source range over its timeline range.

`forward` and `reverse` stretch the source range over the timeline range, so their speed
is the ratio of the two. A loop plays the source range at its own speed for as long as the
timeline range lasts.

oneOf.description: From the start of the source range to its end.

From the end of the source range to its start: pictures in reverse order and sound
played backwards.
One source instant for the whole clip, and silence.

source_time.description: The instant shown; inside the source range.

oneOf.description: The source range again and again, at its own speed.

mode.description: How each pass follows the one before.

TimeScale.description: A positive rational rate of one time against another.

Timeline.description: Timeline tracks ordered from back to front for visual tracks.

Track.description: A homogeneous visual or audio timeline lane.

audio.description: Bus controls applied to this track's mixed audio.

captions.description: The cues and style of a caption track; present exactly for that kind.

clips.description:
Clips on this track, in authoring order; evaluation sorts by time. A caption track has
none.

kind.description: Controls source compatibility and evaluation behavior.

transitions.description: Explicit transitions between overlapping clips on this track.

ducking.description: Optional sidechain attenuation driven by another track.

effects.description:
Ordered single-input effects applied to the summed clip signal, at most
[`MAX_CHAIN_EFFECTS`].

gain.description: Animated linear bus amplitude constrained to `0..=MAX_GAIN`.

pan.description: Animated stereo position applied after the clip mix, from `-1` (left) to `1` (right).

solo.description: Restricts the mix to soloed buses when any track sets this.

TrackKind.description: The media domain accepted by a track.

oneOf.description: A composited visual track.
A mixed audio track.
Timed text, drawn over the tracks before it and under the ones after.

TrackList.description: A grid track list as CSS writes it: "1fr 2fr 120px", "repeat(3, minmax(100px, 1fr))", "repeat(auto-fill, 160px)", "auto min-content max-content", "fit-content(200px)". A bare number is a fraction of the picture's shorter side. Named lines are not supported.

oneOf.description: BT.709 opto-electronic transfer function.

One span over the length of every subpath end to end, in order.

Vec2.description: A two-dimensional value in normalized output coordinates.

VideoStreamShape.description: A video stream's displayed size and frame rate.

frame_rate.description:
The rate the first frames are presented at, measured from packet times and rounded
(`alpha2_assets::FrameRateEvidence`), when measurable. Declared rates are not used because
they are guesses for variable-rate media and browsers report none.

height.description: Displayed height in square pixels, after the pixel aspect ratio and orientation.

width.description: Displayed width in square pixels, after the pixel aspect ratio and orientation.

VisualProperties.description:
Resolution-independent visual presentation controls for a clip.

Omitted fields default to the source centred on the canvas, unscaled, unrotated and opaque.

anchor.description: Unanimated normalized point within the source rectangle.

position.description:
Animated normalized canvas translation, along spatial curves where keyframes have
tangents.

description:
The deserialized shape of a [`Project`] before its invariants are checked.

This is the wire contract the published JSON Schema is derived from; [`Project::validate`]
then decides whether a well-shaped document is valid.

audio.description: Master bus applied to the summed track audio.

effect_resources.description: Non-media resources referenced by effect invocations.

name.description: Human-readable project name. It has no semantic meaning.

schema_version.description: Document version. This build reads and writes only [`CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION`].
